description.mn: Acqua di Parma Gelsomino A Freddo: Unisex модлог үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: ягаан чинжүү, шарилж, нимбэг; суурь ноот: пачули, гваяк мод, нагармота.
description.en: Gelsomino A Freddo, crafted by Acqua di Parma, is a unisex fragrance that debuted in 2025. This captivating scent opens with vibrant top notes of Pink Pepper, Artemisia, and Lemon. At the heart, you'll find a delightful blend of Jasmine, Iris, and Black Tea, while the foundation comprises rich base notes of Patchouli, Guaiac Wood, and Nagarmotha.
